title: Source-bound scheduled-irrigation eligibility gate composition

source.condition: B1.11 proceeds only when sw_irrig=1, schedule=1, irrigevent=0, crop emergence is true and flIrriTime is true

scope: test the existing typed scheduler's full gate conjunction, including its additional selection-opportunity and explicit parameter/request enable checks
100000 deterministic combinations of typed selection opportunity, irrigation enable, schedule enable, emergence, window and fixed-event precedence
verify selection diagnostics and scheduled event creation agree with the typed conjunction; do not claim a one-to-one B1 interface mapping
non_goals: derivation of crop emergence, date window, schedule configuration or fixed-event state
event-calendar parsing, accepted water/solute mass, restart or production admission
pass_conditions: selection is evaluated and an event starts iff all seven typed gates permit the scheduled path
100000 deterministic gate vectors pass at O0/O2 with identical transcripts
